How it stays current: the page reads the group's repository (SantiagoSierraIba/fzs-gold-mining-kpis) every time it opens in a browser. After the notebook code/group5_kpis.Rmd is re-run and pushed, the new numbers appear here. Where the page cannot reach GitHub, it shows the snapshot built into it.

Background: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2025, EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Indicator data: World Bank Pink Sheet, BCRP, Amazon Mining Watch, MapBiomas Peru Collection 4, SERNANP, GADM, as logged in the repository's DOWNLOAD_LOG.csv. All claims are descriptive or predictive, not causal. Student project by ESMT Data for Good, Group 5 (Giant River Turtle); not an official FZS publication.
